config.cohort_rule: All other vehicles scheduled at the same eastbound entry during 07:59:30–08:01:00, regardless of route or outcome.

diagnostic_addendum.purpose: Check opposite-direction trip differences for stochastic-stream divergence beyond direct interaction.
diagnostic_addendum.status: Post-run diagnostic, added before publication; not used for selection or fitting.

config.interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity within an uncalibrated model. Three seeds describe random variation, not confidence or model uncertainty. No psychological adaptation. No held-out data used.
config.selection_rule: First scheduled eastbound full-through trip at or after 08:00; chosen before running altered cases.

source_provenance.source: User-supplied PeMS clearinghouse files; verify origin before scientific use
source_provenance.timezone_assumption: PeMS local civil timestamps interpreted as America/Los_Angeles; confirm for supplied archive
